about_the_game:
This is a text-based puzzle game centered around reasoning, offering you an immersive mental challenge experience.

Core Gameplay:

- Explore a network of information nodes, unlocking fragmented clues by clicking on nodes

- Analyze hidden information within obscure texts and extract key details

- Solve cryptographic puzzles, connect logical chains, and gradually piece together the complete truth

- Every choice affects the direction of the story, experiencing multiple branching narrative developments

Game Features:

- Carefully designed text puzzle system that challenges your logical reasoning abilities

- Complex interconnected storyline network, providing a rich exploration experience

- Diverse puzzle-solving mechanisms, from code cracking to clue integration

- Immersive atmosphere that makes you feel as if you're in a maze of thought

Game Content:

- A complete main storyline with multiple ending branches

- Rich information nodes, each hiding crucial clues

- Various types of puzzle challenges to satisfy different players' reasoning needs

- Meticulously crafted text content, delivering a deep narrative experience

In the game, you will play as a codebreaker, gradually uncovering the hidden truth through wisdom and deduction. Every choice is crucial, and only true reasoning masters can successfully navigate the maze of thought.

We are planning to add more story chapters to the game, further expanding the current storyline and exploring unresolved mysteries. We also hope to optimize the puzzle difficulty curve and experiment with new puzzle-solving mechanics. At the same time, we intend to improve the interface and user experience, fix known issues, and are committed to providing players with a smoother and more immersive gaming experience.

Please note: These are our current development plans and may be adjusted as development progresses. We recommend that you make your purchase decision based on the game's current state rather than expectations of future content.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS *: Windows 7 (32-bit or 64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core 2 Duo E4500 or AMD Athlon 64 X2 5600+
  • Memory: 2 GB MB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated graphics card (supports DirectX 9.0c, e.g., Intel GMA X4500, AMD Radeon HD 3200)
  • Storage: 500 MB available space

short_description: Amid info nodes, you’re a codebreaker—each choice shifts the story. Click nodes for clues, pull key details from text, crack codes, link logic. When all light up, truth emerges: unravel with reason, or get stuck in a thought labyrinth? It depends on your calls.
